configuration.enrollment: device-authorization pairing with client=mobile; subscriber token bound to the endpoint
configuration.pushToken: @react-native-firebase/messaging on both platforms; registered through RegisterEndpoint (pushProvider=fcm, pushToken) and re-sent in every hub Hello
configuration.foreground: SignalR hub connection while active; disconnected when backgrounded so the server routes to push
configuration.iosBuild: EAS Build (no iOS Simulator on Windows)

configuration.credential: Firebase service-account JSON via HashRelay:Push:Fcm:ServiceAccountJson (Container App secret fcm-service-account)
configuration.selection: queued deliveries whose endpoint holds an fcm token and is not live-connected
configuration.evidence: provider acceptance recorded as delivery status 'pushed'; 'acked' only on endpoint acknowledgement (hub Ack or POST .../deliveries/{id}/ack)
configuration.tokenInvalidation: UNREGISTERED / 404 clears the endpoint token and sets PushInvalidatedAt; delivery stays queued for replay
configuration.ios: reached through Firebase's APNs relay with the project's APNs key; no APNs connection in HashRelay

configuration.providerToken: Endpoint.PushProvider + Endpoint.PushToken (secret, never returned); RegisterEndpointRequest.pushProvider/pushToken and HelloRequest.pushProvider/pushToken
configuration.rotation: a new token replaces the old one and clears PushInvalidatedAt; the same token registered by a newer endpoint id is removed from the older one
